domain_description: Teach students to plan, monitor, and evaluate their own learning — through metacognitive prompts, scaffolds, study-strategy guidance, self-explanation, and if-then implementation intentions. All interventions cross-referenced to peer-reviewed meta-analyses where one exists.

skills.description: Build a library of metacognitive prompts that target planning ("What's my goal here?"), monitoring ("Is this working?"), or evaluation ("What worked, what didn't?") — so students develop the habit of asking themselves the right cognitive question at the right moment.
skills.effect_months_source: EEF Toolkit — Metacognition and self-regulation strand
skills.implementation_cost_rationale: Building a prompt library is a one-time prep job — 20-30 prompts cover most tasks; reusable across cohorts. In-lesson use takes seconds (display a prompt, give think time). No materials beyond the prompt list, no training beyond awareness.

skills.description: Generate scaffolds — planning sheets, monitoring checklists, evaluation rubrics — that support students through the three phases of self-regulated learning before, during, and after a task.
skills.effect_months_source: EEF Toolkit — Metacognition and self-regulation strand
skills.implementation_cost_rationale: Designing quality scaffolds for plan/monitor/evaluate phases takes real prep work — calibrating what to scaffold, choosing the right format (sheet, checklist, rubric), planning fade. Once built, scaffolds are reusable across cohorts. AI generation accelerates but doesn't eliminate the design work.

skills.description: Select evidence-based study strategies — spaced practice, retrieval, interleaving, elaboration — matched to the material type, the learning goal, and the student's current habits, so students stop highlighting and re-reading and start doing what actually works.
skills.effect_months_source: EEF Toolkit — Metacognition and self-regulation strand
skills.implementation_cost_rationale: The selector itself is a one-time prep job; in-class use takes minutes of explicit instruction plus reference handouts. No materials beyond a strategy guide, no training beyond teacher fluency with Dunlosky's framework of which strategies actually work.

skills.description: Design prompts that get students to self-explain — 'Why does this step make sense?', 'How does this connect to what you knew before?' — so they generate inferences instead of just absorbing information.
skills.effect_months_source: EEF Toolkit — Metacognition and self-regulation strand
skills.implementation_cost_rationale: Self-explanation prompts are short questions ("Why?", "How does this connect?") that take seconds to deploy and minutes to design. No materials beyond the prompt list. Mechanism works across subjects and grade levels with minimal teacher prep.

skills.description: Help students design if-then plans — "When situation X occurs, I will respond by Y" — so good intentions translate into action. Gollwitzer's classic mechanism for closing the gap between wanting to study and actually studying.
skills.effect_months_source: EEF Toolkit — Metacognition and self-regulation strand
skills.implementation_cost_rationale: If-then plans are a 5-minute activity per student per goal cycle. No materials beyond a template. The technique is teachable in a single short briefing. The cost is the recurring discipline of using them, not setup.
